title: 05.03 - Edit a contribution after submission
intent: Explain under which conditions participants can edit a submitted contribution.
short_answer: It depends on how the survey was set up. Some surveys allow participants to reaccess and edit a submitted contribution, while others do not enable this feature.
procedure: Check whether the survey allows reaccess after submission.
If reaccess is available, open the edit contribution page: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/home/editcontribution.
Enter the Contribution ID that you noted from the Confirmation page or from a related PDF.
Edit the contribution if the survey settings allow it.
If you did not save the Contribution ID, use the Contact us form: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/home/support.
important_conditions: Editing after submission is controlled by the survey configuration.
The Contribution ID is required to identify the submitted contribution.
If the survey does not allow reaccess, you may not be able to edit the submitted contribution.
